summary: Sporting News' Week 14 fantasy football QB rankings for the final week of the regular season, with start/sit advice, streaming options, bust candidates and injury updates. Josh Allen is the QB1 despite a tough matchup at Kansas City, followed by Tua Tagovailoa and Dak Prescott. Cardinals and Commanders are on the last byes, and injuries to Kenny Pickett, Derek Carr and Trevor Lawrence reshape the QB pool.
one_line: Week 14 fantasy football QB rankings with start/sit advice, sleepers, busts and injury updates, led by Josh Allen at QB1.
key_facts: Week 14 is the last week of byes and the end of the fantasy regular season; the Cardinals and Commanders are on bye, so Kyler Murray and Sam Howell are unavailable.
Josh Allen (@ Chiefs) is the QB1 for Week 14, averaging 276.4 passing yards per game with a 14:2 TD-to-INT ratio over five career games against Kansas City.
The Chiefs' defense entered Week 13 allowing the fifth-fewest fantasy points per game to quarterbacks.
Tua Tagovailoa (vs. Titans) is ranked QB2 after throwing for 280 yards and two TDs against the Commanders.
Dak Prescott (vs. Eagles) is a top-three play; he threw for 374 yards and three TDs in a 28-23 loss to the Eagles in Week 9.
Recommended streamers are Gardner Minshew (@ Bengals), Jameis Winston (vs. Panthers), Baker Mayfield (@ Falcons) and Joe Flacco (@ Jaguars).
Joe Flacco racked up 254 yards and two TDs in his first start for the Browns, who did not win; he starts in place of concussed Dorian Thompson-Robinson.
Bust candidates are Matthew Stafford (@ Ravens), Geno Smith (@ 49ers) and Josh Dobbs (@ Raiders); the Ravens allowed the second-fewest FPPG to QBs entering their Week 13 bye.
The Vikings may start Nick Mullens over Josh Dobbs after Dobbs' poor Monday night game against the Bears.
Kenny Pickett (ankle) and Derek Carr (head, shoulder, back) left Week 13 games injured, replaced in the rankings by Mitch Trubisky and Jameis Winston.
Trevor Lawrence suffered an ankle injury on Monday and will likely miss at least a week, opening the door for C.J. Beathard to start vs. the Browns.
Rankings use four-point passing TD scoring; the top 10 are Allen, Tagovailoa, Prescott, Hurts, Mahomes, Lamar Jackson, Goff, Stroud, Purdy and Jordan Love.
